post.summary: Gets CardLink information from CardLink data.
post.description:
Gets CardLink information from CardLink data.

Example code:
device = DesktopReaderService/FindDevice
mediaDefinitions = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/cardLink/mediaDefinitions device.DeviceUid
cardLinkData = DesktopReaderService/Read mediaDefinitions
cardLinkInfos = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/cardLink/cardLinkInfoFromCardLinkData cardLinkData
DesktopReaderService/CloseAll

requestBody.description: The CardLink data read from desktop reader as byte array

get.description:
Gets the CardLink media definitions. The device UID is only required for MIFARE to get the specified site key packet. The device UID can be obtained from the the Desktop Reader Service by calling FindDevice.

Example code:
device = DesktopReaderService/FindDevice
mediaDefinitions = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/cardLink/mediaDefinitions device.DeviceUid
DesktopReaderService/CloseAll

parameters.name: deviceUid
parameters.description: The desktop reader device UID to get the specified site key packet (only for MIFARE)

post.summary: Gets the list of actuators from the free selection data.
post.description:
Gets the list of actuators from the free selection data.

Example code:
device = DesktopReaderService/FindDevice
mediaDefinitions = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/freeSelections/mediaDefinitions device.MediaCodes device.DeviceUid
freeSelectionData = DesktopReaderService/Read mediaDefinitions
actuators = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/freeSelections/actuatorListFromFreeSelectionData freeSelectionData
DesktopReaderService/CloseAll

requestBody.description: The free selection data read from desktop reader as byte array

post.summary: Gets the free selection data for actuator ids.
post.description:
Gets the free selection data for actuator ids.

Example code:
device = DesktopReaderService/FindDevice
mediaDefinitions = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/freeSelections/mediaDefinitions device.MediaCodes device.DeviceUid
freeSelectionData = DesktopReaderService/Read mediaDefinitions
updatedFreeSelections = ExosApi/desktopReader_api/v1.0/freeSelections/freeSelectionDataForActuatorIds mediaDefinitions.Offset mediaDefinitions.Size freeSelectionData actuatorIds
updatedMediaDefinitions = mediaDefinitions
updatedMediaDefinitions.Offset = updatedFreeSelections.Offset
updatedMediaDefinitions.Size = updatedFreeSelections.Data.Size
DesktopReaderService/Write updatedMediaDefinitions updatedFreeSelections.Data
DesktopReaderService/CloseAll

requestBody.description: data passed to get the free selection data for actuator ids.
